name: Falkland Islands
summary_text: Falkland Islands: own legal system; full equality since 2017; tiny, safe, orderly. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: United Kingdom (0.48) plus a local delta of +0.10. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: Judge rules Scottish guidance for housing trans prisoners is unlawful - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This BBC article is about Scotland's prison policy for trans prisoners (June 2026 ruling), not the Falkland Islands; included as UK-context material (the Falklands is a British Overseas Territory).

sources.title: Suicide risk if trans prisoners are put in jails based on sex at birth, court told - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This BBC article is about the same Scottish prison-housing litigation (Feb 2026), not the Falkland Islands; included as UK-context material only.

sources.title: Caymans define marriage amid fears UK will impose civil partnerships | PinkNews
sources.claim_summary: PinkNews (Sept 2008): the Cayman Islands defined marriage as between a man and woman amid fears the UK would impose civil partnerships across the Overseas Territories (including the Falklands) - context of UK-territory LGBT-law dynamics.

sources.title: Falkland Islands introduces full marriage equality | PinkNews
sources.claim_summary: PinkNews (April 2017): the Falkland Islands legalised same-sex marriage and civil partnerships (7-1 vote) after a public consultation found 90% support for same-sex marriage and 94% for civil partnerships - 'an open, tolerant and respectful community'.

sources.title: Falkland Islands Same-Sex Marriage Update – ROB SALERNO
sources.claim_summary: Rob Salerno blog (June 2017): confirmation from the Falklands' registrar general that the same-sex marriage bill received royal assent and is law; also confirms same-sex marriage is NOT legal in South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands.

sources.title: LGBTQ rights in the Falkland Islands explained
sources.claim_summary: Everything Explained summary of LGBTQ rights in the Falkland Islands: legal since 1989, equal age of consent since 2005, marriage and civil partnerships since April 2017, stepchild and joint adoption since 2017, constitutional ban on sexual-orientation discrimination, largely positive attitudes (90% consultation support), first Pride event in Stanley April 2017.
